definitions.explanation: An identification card issued by a school or university to its enrolled students. Used for identification, library access, student discounts, and exams.

examples.japanese: {学生証|がくせいしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せて→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please show me your student ID.

examples.japanese: {学生証|がくせいしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{受|う}けられる→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: If you have a student ID, you can get a discount.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{時|とき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧{学生証|がくせいしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持参|じさん}して→持参する：21143_jisansuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please make sure to bring your student ID when taking exams.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧ (student) and {証|しょう} (certificate, proof).

In Japan, {学生証|がくせいしょう} is essential for student discounts (⟦{学割|がくわり}→学割：18217_gakuwari⟧) on trains, museums, movies, and more. Students typically carry it at all times.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{身分証明書|みぶんしょうめいしょ}→身分証明書：09809_mibunshoumeisho⟧ is a general ID document
- ⟦{社員証|しゃいんしょう}→社員証：22652_shainshou⟧ is an employee ID card
